ctx.x: recorded it, it was "Until the Real Thing Comes Along". Phia Terrell, Fay Terrell, one of my very best friends, did a beautiful job on the vocals, and those are some of the numbers that the composers didn't get credit for.

What was the feeling at the time -- many years ago here in Kansas city with the Kansas City musicians about the controversy of who wrote "Mood Indigo"? Many people, including Barney Bigard Bonnie Bigard and Mrs. Bigard, have said that Barney wrote "Mood Indigo" and of course every credit is given to Duke Ellington. What was the feeling or was there any discussion of this years ago?
There wasn't too much discussion. There wasn't too much doubt that Duke Ellington didn't write it --
